verdict.rationale: Make ships AI features, including AI Agents and an MCP server, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage privacy control. The citations cover only API authentication, webhooks, MCP tools, and audit logs, none of which address AI training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
